summary: Frontend-only testing of the new per-property location map on /web/{id}. All 5 test scenarios + regression on general /web map passed. Map shows with correct dark theme, yellow pin, 'Cómo llegar' link opens Google Maps directions in new tab with correct lat/lng, address text appears below map. Order on properties with both coords+video is correct: map first then Video block. Properties without coords degrade gracefully (no map). Mobile viewport (390x844) renders without horizontal overflow. Regression on /web list/map toggle still works after googleMapTheme.ts extraction.

design_issues.screen: PublicPropertyDetail (desktop with coords only, no video)
issues: Ubicación/map sits in a right-side column alongside the gallery, leaving a large empty space below the map. Not a bug but when there's no video and no other side content the right column looks sparse.

critical_code_review_comments: google.maps.Marker deprecation warning in console (library-level, @vis.gl/react-google-maps). Not blocking but migrating to AdvancedMarkerElement in future would silence warnings.
PropertyMap gracefully returns null when API key missing — good.
The condition `typeof data.latitude === 'number'` correctly excludes null/undefined. Good guard.
